validation.notes: Official emblem of the Indian National Science Academy, the awarding body named in the record's official_source ('Indian National Science Academy (INSA) for Department of Science & Technology (DST), Govt. of India'). Domain insaindia.res.in is INSA's own site and is the record's official_source host. GET verified 200, image/png, 337938 bytes, 529x529. The ISRF Call 2025-26 page (title 'ISRF Call 2025-26 - Indian National Science Academy') carries this emblem in its site header as a 150x150 scaled copy of the same artwork at wp-content/uploads/2022/11/insa_logo-1-1-1.png; the 529x529 original in wp-content/uploads/2022/09/ was chosen for resolution. ISRF itself publishes no separate programme logo: the only other image on the ISRF call page is imageonline-co-transparentimage-1.png, a third-party web-image-hosting mark.

records.title: International Graduate Student Scholarship (IGSS)

validation.notes: The official Universiti Putra Malaysia logo lockup as served in the site header of UPM's main official website: the UPM crest beside the 'UPM' wordmark and the lines 'UNIVERSITI PUTRA MALAYSIA' and 'BERILMU BERBAKTI'. Identity is unambiguous and matches official_source 'Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM), School of Graduate Studies'. Domain www.upm.edu.my is UPM's own official domain. GET verified 200, image/jpeg, 1750822 bytes, 3543x2126. The record's own official_source_url (the School of Graduate Studies page at sgs.upm.edu.my) carries no UPM logo of publishable quality - it shows only /assets/images/logoupm.png at 117x50 (verified 200, image/png, 8686 bytes, same artwork) alongside /assets/images/jatanegara.png, which is Malaysia's federal Jata Negara emblem rather than a UPM mark. The full-resolution master from the university's main domain was therefore preferred; the School of Graduate Studies uses the identical logo, so identity is consistent across both official hosts. The IGSS scheme itself publishes no dedicated programme logo; /summer-uploads/20171213121134blobid0.jpg on the SGS page is decorative header art (a 147px-tall banner above the H2 heading), not a logo.

source.raw_extract: Header image markup, verbatim from the UPM homepage: "" (the only full-size header logo; the sole sibling reference is the WordPress-generated crop ""). Artwork verified visually: UPM crest + 'UPM' + 'UNIVERSITI PUTRA MALAYSIA' + 'BERILMU BERBAKTI'.
